kofi.goal.description: Reads the Ko-fi goal Cuebot keeps from Ko-fi payments (set it up on the Webhooks page).
kofi.goal.returns: title, current, target, percent, currency and reached (true once the target was reached).

kofi.setGoal.description: Changes the Ko-fi goal. Leave out anything you want to keep.

parameters.title: Optional. The goal's name.
parameters.target: Optional. The target; 0 turns the goal off.
parameters.startAmount: Optional. What your Ko-fi goal showed before Cuebot counted.
parameters.currency: Optional. Only payments in this currency count, like "USD".

kofi.setGoal.returns: The goal after the change, like kofi.goal.

kofi.addToGoal.description: Adds an amount to the Ko-fi goal by hand. A negative amount takes it away.
kofi.addToGoal.returns: The goal after the change, like kofi.goal.

kofi.resetGoal.description: Starts the Ko-fi goal again from its start amount.

parameters.clearStart: Optional. true sets the start amount to 0 too.

kofi.resetGoal.returns: The goal after the reset, like kofi.goal.

kofi.commissions.description: Lists Ko-fi commissions, oldest first. Only open ones unless includeDone is true.

parameters.includeDone: Optional. true lists finished ones too.

kofi.commissions.returns: A list. Each has id, name, message, amount, currency, formattedAmount, time and done.

parameters.which: Optional. Its id or its number in the open list (1 is the oldest). Leave out for the oldest.

kofi.completeCommission.returns: The finished commission (id, name, message), or null when there was none.

kofi.members.description: Lists the Ko-fi members Cuebot has seen pay, newest payment first. Ko-fi never says when a membership ends, so lapsed is an estimate.
kofi.members.returns: A list. Each has name, tier, discordUserId, lastPayment, payments and lapsed.
